patterns.message: Leaf modules import nothing from src: every other layer may depend on them, never the other way. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/state.ts and src/snapshot.ts may import only leaf modules and each other. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/browser.ts may import only leaf modules (daemon/protocol.ts among them), state and snapshot: the daemon owns the browser, not the other way. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/daemon may import only leaf modules, state, snapshot, browser and daemon: commands reach the daemon, never the other way. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/daemon/client.ts is the command side of the socket: it may import only leaf modules, state, snapshot and daemon/protocol, never the browser or the daemon process (server.ts, main.ts). Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/commands talk to the daemon only through daemon/client.ts and daemon/protocol.ts (never browser.ts, daemon/server.ts or daemon/main.ts), and from src/cli use only cli/parser.ts: cli/registry.ts collects the commands. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/cli may import only cli, commands and leaf modules: it reaches the daemon through commands. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.

src/mcp.ts may import cli, commands and leaf modules, never cli.ts: cli.ts is mid-evaluation when it loads mcp.ts, and importing it back deadlocked the old compiled binary. Layers depend only downward: leaves (errors, page-scripts, serialize, socket-write, daemon/protocol, daemon/pidfile) → state, snapshot → browser → daemon → commands → cli → mcp → cli.ts.
